{{Quote|My brew ain't good enough for you? Then you're in the wrong place, Sith. Sorry it ain't suited to your delicate tastes, but we serve mostly space trash and moisture farmers. And none of them is delicate.|Regg|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Siltshift cantina''', also known as the '''Rodian's Revenge''', was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the settlement of [[Mos Ila]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Owned by a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Regg]], the cantina had two levels, as well as entertainment and vendors. An example of this was the [[Astromechalla]] band that played there during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].
